scope: existing pilot only; no held-out test tuning; no new capture
latency: per-frame point projection + detection + tracking, not ROS/display; thread caps 1
metric_limit: Geometric pairing only; cylinder support is an approximate visibility proxy, not pixel-instance semantic truth

variant_policy.generalized_3d_classifier: Frozen 3D proposals + original score prior at 0.45
variant_policy.three_d_no_prior_045: Exactly same 3D proposals/classifier; base score >=0.45, no multiplicative prior
variant_policy.three_d_no_prior_050: Same no-prior branch, fixed 0.50 score-matched control; not tuned

stop_rule: One fixed run of four variants; report all outcomes, no confidence sweep or per-scene fitting
stage_policy: 3D pre-planar proposals include envelope/density/size/torso cropping. Stage GT set losses/gains are reported; no claim of pure clustering attribution.
training_candidate_rule: Keep 3D proposal provider only if no_prior_050 satisfies local gate on both episodes; otherwise use high-recall legacy 2D proposals for a learned point encoder candidate. Neither condition authorizes training or deployment.
generalization_gate: Local same-avatar results cannot pass generalization. Fresh scene+asset-family splits and proper labels required.
future_classifier: One small PointNet-style binary head on observed XYZ patches; baseline depth_linear remains comparator. No pre-trained person weights or accuracy claim.
